project(tidy)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME blitz-tidy)
target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"source/main.cpp"
	"source/config.hpp"
	"source/config.cpp"
	"source/engine.hpp"
	"source/engine.cpp"
	"source/rules.hpp"
	"source/rules.cpp"
)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE blitzfront tools)
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE BLITZLLVM_VERSION="${CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION}")

install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT system EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
